author: Garys Economics
description:
TV and radio discussion on wealth taxes usually get derailed by fear mongering and terrible statistics – often from people who are paid to defend the ultra rich. What would an honest debate about wealth inequality and taxing wealth actually look like?

How to Get Filthy Rich: My Channel4 Documentary – https://www.channel4.com/programmes/how-to-get-filthy-rich-with-gary-stevenson/on-demand/78427-001
The Big Issue edition I edited – https://www.bigissue.com/behind-the-scenes/inside-the-big-issue-gary-says-wealth-tax/ 
My website that explains What is Wealth and Inequality – https://garyseconomics.org/introduction/
